title: AI Bootstrap Auditor: a self-testing statistical harness for AI release decisions
description: Paired-bootstrap GO / REVIEW-RETEST / NO-GO verdicts for AI evaluation metrics, non-inferiority guardrails, batch multiple-comparison correction, sample-size planning, and a self-audit suite (calibration, metamorphic and differential tests). Includes a Streamlit app, a CI release-gate API, and a real-data case study (Mistral-7B-Instruct v0.1 to v0.2). Live app: https://ai-bootstrap-auditor.streamlit.app
